name: Financial Assistance to Authors for Book Publication
benefit: Under this scheme, the department provides financial assistance to eminent litterateurs, writers, and poets of the state whose works remain unpublished due to lack of funds.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a native or permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an eminent litterateur, writer, author, or poet. 1. The applicant’s literary work must remain unpublished solely due to financial constraints.
